A podcast editor has an hour of conversation and thirty seconds to make a stranger care.
The hardest choice is where to begin.
Start too late, and the audience hears the punchline without the question.
End too soon, and a change of heart sounds like a contradiction.
Paste a recording, set your running time, and compare a few editorial directions.
Read the lines behind each suggestion.
You choose the one that deserves to leave the cutting room.
Your edits teach the studio your voice.
Your audience’s retention helps shape the next cut.
